backend.stopped: The Quality Assurance backend is not running, nothing is being recorded.
backend.startFailed: The backend could not be started: {error}

job.distribution: Filament monitor reading, time per 2 % class (s)

layers.none: No layers recorded for this job.
layers.gearPassesHint: How often each piece of filament passed the extruder gear: 1 without retraction, 3 when it went back and forth once, 5 twice. Counted from the G-code, the macros it calls, M207 and the e-steps valid during the print.
layers.feedHint: Filament the extruder pushed per millimetre of the G-code, compared with the start of the print: e-steps / e-steps when it first fed × extrusion factor (M221). 104 % after the filament monitor's M92 correction from 801 to 834.
layers.filamentHint: Commanded: extrusion the filament monitor saw commanded; measured: movement it measured (calibrated.totalDistance).

channels.pruned: The raw data of this job was removed by retention; layers, events and the summary remain.
channels.downsampled: More points than can be shown: every n-th point is drawn.

events.unconfirmedHint: Cleared within 500 ms: the board itself reports open load only after 500 ms

eventTypes.filament_percent_drift: Monitor drifts away from its level

hint.heater_load_mean: Mean load of each nozzle heater at its setpoint, per setpoint and nozzle. A rising load at the same setpoint, material and nozzle points at a weakening heater or a starting blockage.
hint.fm_avg_percentage: The monitor's average of the whole job. A slow drift over jobs points at wear of drive gear, idler or bearing.
hint.filament_ratio: Filament measured by the monitor per filament commanded, over the whole job.
hint.mm_per_rev: What RRF calibrated the monitor's sensitivity to in each job.
hint.esteps_suggested: The correction the machine's flow-bias detector suggested.
hint.heat_up_s: Time from a new setpoint to reaching it, first time in each job.
hint.duration_s: Job duration as RRF reports it.
hint.events: Events of a job without start and end.
hint.spectrum_peak_hz: Mean peak frequency of a job's accelerometer spectra per axis (from 5 Hz on). A shift points at belt tension, bearings or loose parts.
hint.spectrum_rms: Mean vibration RMS of a job's accelerometer recordings per axis, without gravity.

settings.timelapseM240: A job whose G-code sends M240 (trigger camera, e.g. from a slicer macro that parks the head) gets its frames from M240; the print waits for each photo. The camera shows the machine late, so the photo waits until the picture has stood still (0 = only the fixed wait). Otherwise a frame is taken at each layer change.
settings.chamberAutoHint: Chamber heater, else the sensor named under “Sensor name”

fields.filamentLevelPoints: Monitor away from its level in the job
fields.filamentPercentWindowMinS: Monitor outside its window or level at least
fields.filamentLevelMinS: Monitor level counts after readings of
fields.filamentDriftPoints: Monitor drift: layer mean away from the level by
fields.filamentDriftLayers: Monitor drift: layers in a row
fields.retentionJobs: Keep raw data of the newest jobs
fields.contextGlobals: Global variables stored with each job
fields.mfm: Record the machine's filament monitor evaluation (MFM globals)
fields.settleMs: Timelapse: M240 photo no earlier than
fields.stillMs: Timelapse: M240 photo once the picture stood still for
fields.stillMaxMs: Timelapse: M240 photo at the latest after
fields.keepFramesOnFailure: Keep the frames when encoding fails

settings.accelHint: Spectra are recorded only from the accelerometer on this board (CHX 350: the SZP, 60).
settings.accelNone: The machine has no accelerometer configured (M955).

replay.legend: Colour: commanded volumetric flow from the G-code; dots: measured extrusion rate (same scale); rings: events. Wheel zooms, drag pans, double click fits.
replay.curves: Temperature and heater load of the layer
replay.building: The daemon is still indexing the G-code file…
replay.fileGone: The job file is no longer on the printer, or it was changed after the job.
replay.noLayer: The G-code file has no such layer.

timelapse.none: No timelapse was recorded for this job ({reason}).
timelapse.capturing: One frame is taken per finished layer; the video follows after the job.
timelapse.encoding: The video is encoded while no job prints; meanwhile the captured frames are shown.
timelapse.pruned: The timelapse files were removed by the timelapse retention.
timelapse.frameOfEarlier: Camera after layer {layer} (no frame of its own for this layer)
timelapse.noFrame: No camera frame for this layer.

spectra.none: No vibration spectra for this job (accelerometer off or not configured, or the job printed shorter than the first recording).
spectra.referenceAuto: Reference: median of the first {count} spectra of this axis.
spectra.referenceAutoPartial: Reference: median of the first {count} of {total} spectra (still collecting).
spectra.compare: Spectra of the last jobs against the reference

embed.noJob: Quality assurance has not recorded a job yet.
